installGuide.title: How to install an eSIM
installGuide.iphoneTitle: How to install eSIM on iPhone
installGuide.androidTitle: How to install eSIM on Android
iphoneSteps: After purchase, tap “Install eSIM” — or scan the QR code from another device.
Wait for the eSIM to install.
When you arrive, turn on Data Roaming for the eSIM line and enjoy the internet.
androidSteps: Tap SIMs → Add eSIM (or “Download a SIM instead”).
Scan the QR code, or enter the SM-DP+ address and activation code manually.
When you arrive, turn on mobile data and roaming for the eSIM line.
installGuide.androidNote: Menu names vary by manufacturer (Samsung, Pixel and others), but the steps are the same.
tips: Install while you're on Wi-Fi, before you travel.
Don't delete the eSIM after installing it.
Your plan starts on your first connection in the destination.

faqItems.a: An eSIM is a digital SIM built into your phone. Instead of inserting a plastic SIM card, you install a data plan over the air — so you can get online abroad without swapping or losing your usual SIM.

faqItems.q: Which phones support eSIM, and how do I check?
faqItems.a: Most recent iPhones (XR/XS and later), Google Pixel (3 and later) and many Samsung Galaxy models support eSIM. To check: on iPhone open Settings → General → About and look for an EID; on Android dial *#06# and look for an EID number. If your phone has an EID, it supports eSIM.

Your plan activates when you first connect to a network in your destination — not when you install the eSIM. You can install it any time before you travel; the validity period only starts counting on first connection.

faqItems.q: How do I install the eSIM on iPhone?
faqItems.a: After your purchase, tap “Install eSIM” (or scan the QR code from another device), then go to Settings → Cellular → Add eSIM and follow the prompts. When you arrive, turn on Data Roaming for the eSIM line. See “How to install an eSIM” for the full steps.

faqItems.q: How do I install the eSIM on Android?
faqItems.a: Go to Settings → Network & internet (or Connections) → SIMs → Add eSIM / Download a SIM, then scan the QR code or enter the SM-DP+ address and activation code manually. Menu names vary by manufacturer. When you arrive, turn on mobile data and roaming for the eSIM line.

faqItems.q: Do I need to turn on data roaming?
faqItems.a: Yes — turn on Data Roaming for the eSIM line only. Your eSIM connects to local networks as a roaming line, so roaming must be on for it to work. Keeping data on the eSIM line avoids roaming charges on your normal number.

faqItems.q: Will my normal phone number keep working?
faqItems.a: Yes. The eSIM is a second line, so your regular SIM and number stay active for calls and texts (dual SIM). Keep mobile data on the eSIM line to avoid roaming charges on your home plan.

faqItems.q: What happens when my data runs out?
faqItems.a: You can top up any time in the app — open My eSIMs, choose the eSIM and tap “Top up”. Some top-ups add to your current plan; others replace it, and you'll always see which before you pay.
If we can't issue your eSIM, you're refunded automatically — no action needed. For any other refund question, contact our support team and we'll help.

faqItems.q: Can I use one eSIM on two phones?
faqItems.a: No. Each eSIM can be installed and active on a single device only. If you need data on another phone, buy a separate eSIM for it.
